rows.title: Stock split
rows.summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 21, 2025, has considered and approved subdivision of 1988752989 equity shares of Rs. 5 each into 9943764945 equity shares of Re. 1 each.

rows.headline: Intimation Attached
rows.subject: Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On Friday, November 21, 2025
rows.title: Intimation Attached
Stock split
rows.summary: We wish to inform you pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30(2) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III thereto that the Board of Directors of the Bank have, at their meeting held today on the occasion of 40th Foundation Day, i.e., on November 21, 2025, inter alia, considered and approved sub-division (split) of the existing equity shares of the Bank, as follows:Sub-division (split) of 1 (One) existing equity share of the Bank having face value of Rs. 5/- (Rupees Five only) each, fully paid-up, into 5 (Five) equity shares of the Bank having face value of Re. 1/- (Rupee One only) each, fully paid-up.Consequently, the Board of Directors have also approved a proposal to suitably amend the Capital Clause of the Memorandum of Association of the Bank, to give effect to the aforesaid sub-division of equity shares.Both the aforesaid approvals are subject further to the approval/certification of the members, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and any other regulatory/statutory authority, as may be required in this regard.
